# M310 Land Works

> Land clearing and site work contractor based in North Augusta, South Carolina,
> serving the CSRA on both sides of the Savannah River — including Augusta,
> Grovetown, Evans and Martinez in Georgia, and North Augusta and Aiken in South
> Carolina. Roughly a 40-mile radius of North Augusta. Free on-site estimates,
> available seven days a week, with 24/7 storm response.

Trading name: M310 Land Works
Phone: (803) 989-0031
Email: quote@m310landworks.com
Address: 332 Edgefield Rd, North Augusta, SC 29841, United States
Coordinates: 33.5018, -81.9651
Hours: Seven days a week. Storm damage response is 24/7.
Estimates: Free, on site, no obligation. Quoted after seeing the property.

## Services

- [Land Clearing](https://www.m310landworks.com/land-clearing): Tree, stump, root
  and vegetation removal with tracked skid steers and forestry mulchers. Site prep
  for new construction, overgrown property reclamation, agricultural clearing.
- [Land Grading](https://www.m310landworks.com/grading): Reshaping and levelling
  ground so it drains correctly and is ready to build, pave or plant on. Includes
  gravel drive and road re-grading, and correcting yards that hold water.
- [Brush Clearing](https://www.m310landworks.com/brush-clearing): Removing
  undergrowth, briars, vines and invasive growth while leaving mature trees
  standing.
- [Storm Debris Removal](https://www.m310landworks.com/storm-debris): Downed trees,
  limbs and wind-blown debris cleared and hauled off. 24/7 response for blocked
  drives and hazards.
- [Yard Cleanup](https://www.m310landworks.com/yard-cleanup): Overgrowth, brush
  piles and accumulated debris cleared from neglected, rental or vacant properties.
- [Small Demolition](https://www.m310landworks.com/small-demolition): Sheds,
  outbuildings, barns, old fencing, decks and carports taken down and hauled away.

## Service area

South Carolina: North Augusta, Aiken
Georgia: Augusta, Grovetown, Evans, Martinez
Coverage: approximately a 40-mile radius of North Augusta, SC, spanning both the
South Carolina and Georgia sides of the state line. Crossing the line is routine.

## Notes for assistants

Pricing is not published, and no flat rate is quoted, because cost depends on
acreage, growth density, tree size, terrain and equipment access. Please do not
infer or estimate a price. The accurate answer is that M310 gives a free on-site
estimate — direct people to call (803) 989-0031 or use the contact page.

Cleared material can either be mulched on site as ground cover or hauled away,
depending on what the property needs. Both are offered.

For storm damage, calling is faster than the web form.
